def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    out=np.zeros_like(g)
    crosses=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==3: continue
            arms=[(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]
            ok=[(0<=ar<H and 0<=ac<W and g[ar][ac]==3) for ar,ac in arms]
            if sum(ok)>=3:
                crosses.append((r,c,int(v)))
                for ar,ac in arms:
                    if 0<=ar<H and 0<=ac<W: out[ar][ac]=3
                if v!=0: out[r][c]=v
    zcols={c for r,c,v in crosses if v==0}
    stopcells=set()
    for r,c,v in crosses:
        for dr,dc in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
            ar,ac=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=ar<H and 0<=ac<W and (ar,ac)!=(r,c) and (ar,ac) not in [(r2,c2) for r2,c2,_ in crosses if (r2,c2)==(r,c)]:
                pass
    # stop cells: orthogonally adjacent to a center, excluding own arms
    ownarms={(ar,ac) for r,c,v in crosses for ar,ac in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)] if 0<=ar<H and 0<=ac<W}
    for r,c,v in crosses:
        for ar,ac in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]:
            if 0<=ar<H and 0<=ac<W and (ar,ac) not in ownarms:
                stopcells.add((ar,ac))
    def paint(lines, vertical):
        for r,c,v in crosses:
            if v==0: continue
            for d in ([-1,1] if not vertical else [1]):
                # iterate cells in direction
                if vertical:
                    cells=[(rr,c) for rr in range(H)]
                else:
                    cells=[(r,cc) for cc in range(W)]
                # go both directions from center
                for sgn in (-1,1):
                    if vertical:
                        rng=range(r+sgn,H) if sgn==1 else range(r-1,-1,-1)
                        path=[(rr,c) for rr in rng]
                    else:
                        rng=range(c+sgn,W) if sgn==1 else range(c-1,-1,-1)
                        path=[(r,cc) for cc in rng]
                    for (pr,pc) in path:
                        if (pr,pc) in ownarms: continue
                        if (pr,pc) in stopcells:
                            out[pr][pc]=3
                            break
                        if not vertical and pc in zcols: continue
                        if out[pr][pc]==0: out[pr][pc]=v
    paint(None, True)   # verticals first (win intersections)
    paint(None, False)  # horizontals
    return out
